question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Both Renu and her sister is very tall and are in the basketball team.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'is very tall'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence has a **subject-verb **disagreement.
